verdict.rationale: Benchmark's own API can set up a campaign's name, subject line, sender details and recipient list, and can duplicate a prior campaign to inherit its design. The docs then say to open the campaign in Benchmark to make final edits and send, so the flow is not dashboard-free. missing for 10: API-based scheduling or sending of campaigns, setting campaign content/design via API, a fully dashboard-free end-to-end flow, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec (probes 404), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Duplicate a previous campaign via the API to inherit its design, then open it in Benchmark to make final edits and send.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
